scope: Read-only test-source inventory during the frozen baseline; not an executed result, a product diagnosis, a speedup claim or a new test specification.

fixture_classes.TestRigidPortConnector: Real native FreeCAD CAD/ObjectsFem objects with two manually authored eight-node volume regions and sparse physical IDs. No target-module mocks; most tests resolve or export without a solver. Three ccx-gated methods additionally solve tiny prescribed rigid-port cases.
fixture_classes.TestElasticConnector: Real native FreeCAD vertex references and manually authored small FemMesh objects. Some emitter checks use a SimpleNamespace writer carrier, not a concrete full writer. No target-module mocks.
fixture_classes.TestElasticConnectorCalculiX: ccx-gated real FemToolsCcx.run through stock writer/import, with an independently checked small finite block plus isolated connector endpoint nodes. Not the finite-backbone132-bay capacity graph.
fixture_classes.TestTieOwnership: gmsh-gated independently meshed touching CAD boxes, native second-order tetrahedra and owned face/volume group provenance. Stock export only, no CalculiX solve. Two lower-level getter tests use a SimpleNamespace analysis-member carrier with real native meshes.
fixture_classes.TestTieShellCompatibility: Real native CAD planes and manually authored two Tri3 mesh faces; stock writer, no Gmsh or solver required.

tests.name: TestRigidPortConnector.test_shared_port_resolution_preserves_independent_mutable_regions
tests.seam: Public PortResolutionContext plus resolve_connector on actual native objects
tests.behavior: Returned regions are mutable sets; clearing one returned region does not alter a later resolution using the same explicit context. bodies remain native objects, nodes remains an empty list.
tests.boundary: Real small fixture; no mocks, no writer or solve

tests.name: TestRigidPortConnector.test_stock_reexports_resolve_changed_regions_mesh_and_native_ids
tests.seam: FemToolsCcx.update_objects/write_inp_file, inspecting actual emitted NSETs
tests.behavior: One tool is reused after a valid export, an overlapping-reference failure, a changed receiving face, replacement sparse-ID mesh and Analysis.Group RBE reorder. Expected receiving-node sets and newly allocated reference/rotation/connector IDs are literal assertions.
tests.boundary: Concrete stock export and native CAD/mesh, no target mocks or solve

tests.name: TestRigidPortConnector.test_direct_writes_after_completed_and_failed_full_exports_are_fresh
tests.seam: Concrete MeshSetsGetter/FemInputWriterCcx.write_solver_input followed by public write_connectors/write_constraint emitters
tests.behavior: Reuses the exact writer after either completed or failed full export, then replaces sparse mesh and changes group order; direct connector/RBE NSETs must use current allocation. An overlap is also rejected by a direct write after completed export.
tests.boundary: Concrete writer/getter with real native inputs; no mocks or solver. This is not the high-level tool-only seam.

tests.name: TestRigidPortConnector.test_explicit_ports_native_units_and_sparse_node_allocation

tests.behavior: Native bodies and regions are resolved; rotational stiffness has expected units/value; allocated native IDs lie above all sparse physical IDs.
tests.boundary: Native objects, direct public resolution, no solver

tests.name: TestRigidPortConnector.test_ports_fail_closed_for_implicit_or_invalid_coupling

tests.boundary: Native input edits, no mocks or writer

tests.boundary: Native CAD/hand-authored shell mesh/stock writer, no Gmsh, solver or mocks

coverage_limits_not_product_findings: No timing or operation-count acceptance for the full132-bay public call appears in these two files. The new frozen baseline is diagnostic; no speedup is inferred here.

Full stock context-freshness tests use two small rigid regions and one connector. They do not by themselves qualify simultaneous264 moving finite-face ports,264 cuts,792 connectors and V3 force/contact/MPC/physical-support accounting.

Public mutable-container isolation explicitly covers returned region sets. It does not assert ownership/copy semantics of every other mutable result member, nor should such semantics be invented without a confirmed contract.

Between-export reference/remesh/group-order changes and success/error cleanup are covered. A physical model mutation while one explicit per-operation context remains live is not specified here; this is not evidence of a bug or permission to broaden that context lifetime.
Tie geometry-child reorder and native group/provenance changes are covered through remesh; this is not a direct arbitrary permutation test of semantically identical mesh-group iteration order.
Placed parents/links/orientation edits are covered by resolver and emitter tests, not a complete high-level full132-bay re-export after placement changes.
Real CalculiX methods have explicit ccx availability gates and Tie ownership methods require gmsh. Source inspection does not prove any method executed or passed in the current run.
